The ILPA Reporting Template (the “Reporting Template”) was first developed in 2016 to promote more uniform reporting practices in the PE industry related to fees, expenses and carried interest [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.1].

Returned Clawback  Excess carried interest paid to the investment adviser or any of its related persons, including amounts held in escrow, which has been returned to the private fund [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Offering/Syndication Costs  Fees/costs incurred to market or sell an interest in the private fund [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Offering/Syndication Costs  A.1 NAV Reconciliation and Summary of Fees, Expenses & Carried Interest [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2].

Management Fee Rebate  Refund of any prior management fees to the Fund's investors [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Management Fees – Net of Offsets, Waivers & Rebates  Periodic gross management fees, less any offsets, fee waivers and fee rebates (applied during the period) [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4].

Partnership Expenses – Bank Fees  Fees/expenses allocated to or paid by the private fund for banking services [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. (Partnership Expenses – Bank Fees)  A.1 NAV Reconciliation and Summary of Fees, Expenses & Carried Interest > Partnership Expenses – External [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2].

Carried Interest Accrued (Unrealized Profits)  Periodic change in the investment adviser's or any of its related persons' share of any unrealized profits from portfolio investments (a.k.a [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Carried Interest Accrued (Unrealized Profits)  A.1 NAV Reconciliation and Summary of Fees, Expenses & Carried Interest > Investment Income [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2].

Unapplied Offset Balance (Roll-forward) – Beginning Balance  Prior period, ending-balance for any fees/expenses, subject to offset against the private fund's fees/expenses, that have been recognized, but not yet credited to the benefit of the private fund's investors [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Unapplied Offset Balance (Roll-forward) – Ending Balance  A.1 NAV Reconciliation and Summary of Fees, Expenses & Carried Interest > Partnership Expenses – External (calculated row) [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2].

Dividend Income  Dividend income received by the private fund from portfolio investments [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Dividend Income  A.1 NAV Reconciliation and Summary of Fees, Expenses & Carried Interest > Investment Income [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2].

Broken Deal Fee Offset  A.1 NAV Reconciliation and Summary of Fees, Expenses & Carried Interest > Partnership Expenses – External [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2]. Broken Deal Fees  Termination fees/expenses received from counterparties of the private fund's unconsummated deals, netted against any termination fees/expenses paid to counterparties that weren't reimbursed by the private fund (include any fees not subject to offset) [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4].

Total Reimbursements for Travel & Administrative Expenses  Repayment of any travel or other administrative expenses from the Fund's portfolio investment to the investment adviser or any of its related persons [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Total Reimbursements for Travel & Administrative Expenses****  B.1 With Respect to the Private Fund's Portfolio Companies/Investments [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2].

Interest Income  Net interest income (expense) received by the private fund from portfolio investments [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Interest Income  A.1 NAV Reconciliation and Summary of Fees, Expenses & Carried Interest > Investment Income [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2].

GP's Allocation of Total Fund  Balances that represent the equity interest, including carried interest, in the fund of the investment adviser, or any of its related persons, that manage or exert control over the private fund, including the General Partner or Managing Member [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. Carried Interest – Paid During the Period  The investment adviser's or any of its related persons' share of any realized profits from a portfolio investment (a.k.a [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4].

Cumulative LPs' Allocation of Total Fund  Balances that represent the cumulative interest of a single fund, including all of its side/parallel vehicles (current and liquidated), less the GP's Allocation of Total Fund [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4].

With Respect to the Fund's Portfolio Companies/Investments  Fees, expenses and reimbursements paid/accrued by (or in regards to) the Fund's portfolio holdings to the investment adviser and any of its related persons; Include any fees received from third-parties regarding arrangements for the investment (i.e., purchasing discount fees), and any fees received after the liquidation of the Fund or any sleeve/AIV of the Fund [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. ***Balances in this section represent fees & reimbursements received by the Investment Adviser & Related Persons with respect to the Fund's investments that are not allocable to the Total Fund (i.e., allocated to ownership interests of LP co-investors & other vehicles managed-by/affiliated-with the Investment Adviser/Related Person); To avoid double-counting, LP # 5's Allocation of Total Fund should not reflect any pro-rata share of these positions; Balances in this section, plus the balances in the "Cumulative LPs' Allocation of Total Fund" section, should equal the total fees/reimbursements received by the Investment Adviser & Related Persons With Respect to the Fund's Portfolio Companies/Investments [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.2].

LP's Allocation of Total Fund  Balances that represent the single investor's interest in the total private fund [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4]. This will typically only impact the LP's Allocation of Total Fund section as the transfers from investors are netted" transactions in the Total Fund (including GP Allocation) and GP's Allocation of Total Fund sections [ILPA_Reporting_Template_v2.0, p.4].
